meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 让 Claude 接入 Slack，能够在 Slack 的频道和私聊中收发消息；安装过程会复制适配器、注册并配置密钥，支持 Socket Mode 或 Webhook 两种接收方式。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 Slack，或正在执行 /setup、/init-first-agent、/manage-channels 等初始化/接线流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 频道接进来
say.note: 开始复制适配器并引导配置。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 连接 Slack
say.note: 会要求创建 Slack 应用并粘贴 token。

say.text: 配置 Slack 的 webhook 接收
say.note: 引导设置公网 URL 和签名密钥。

howto.what_en: Adds Slack channel support, letting Claude exchange messages in Slack channels and direct messages. The setup copies the Slack adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, and configures credentials for Socket Mode or webhook delivery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to integrate Slack, or while running setup flows like /setup, /init-first-agent, or /manage-channels.

say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and configuring.
Prompts for Slack app setup and tokens.
Guides through public URL and signing secret.
